text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon finishes the Kikuka Sho
with
favorable results.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta say, Agnes Tachyon
performed better
than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she ran with all her heart. Is she
really a
problem child like they say?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon's full sprint has inspired
a change
of heart in those watching her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haha... AHAHAHA! Not bad! Not bad at
all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her smile is so bright that I
unconsciously take a
step back.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I think so too! If only I could copy
the
memory from my mind and save it
somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Either way, this is just the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. It's time I fulfilled my promise
to you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Once you're ready, let's meet in your
office. I
have something to tell you.
